name: jean-claude
description: Claude Code helper: blinking session tabs, notification sounds for the right VS Code window, Claude.ai usage limits in the status bar, and rainbow-colored CSV columns
author: Tomas Janu

jeanClaude.usageMonitor.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable the usage monitor that displays Claude.ai usage limits in the status bar.

⚠️ **Billing notice (April 2026):** This feature calls the Anthropic API using your OAuth token or session cookie. Under the new billing policy, third-party API access is no longer covered by your Claude subscription and may incur extra usage charges. [Learn more](https://claude.ai).

You can also turn this on or off by clicking **Jean Claude** in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect OAuth token from Claude Code credentials, fall back to session cookie
jeanClaude.authMethod.description: Authentication method for fetching usage data

jeanClaude.sessionKey.description: Session key cookie from claude.ai (required if authMethod is 'cookie')

jeanClaude.blinkingTabs.enabled.markdownDescription:
Make the status dot on Claude Code session tabs blink: **blue** = the session is waiting for you, **orange** = it finished and you have not looked yet. Jean Claude adds a small CSS animation to the Claude Code extension's tab icons (re-applied after every Claude Code update). Reload the window after changing this.

You can also turn this on or off by clicking **Jean Claude** in the status bar.

jeanClaude.notificationSound.enabled.markdownDescription:
Play a sound when a Claude Code session in this VS Code window asks for input or finishes a task (sessions in the Claude desktop app or other terminals are ignored). Adds the needed hooks to `~/.claude/settings.json` when turned on.

You can also turn this on or off by clicking **Jean Claude** in the status bar.

jeanClaude.notificationSound.showNotific.description: Show a Windows notification when Claude Code needs attention and VS Code is not focused

jeanClaude.notificationSound.flashTaskba.description: Flash this VS Code window in the taskbar when Claude Code needs attention and VS Code is not focused (Windows)

jeanClaude.notificationSound.onQuestion.description: Play a sound when Claude Code asks for user input (e.g. tool approval)

jeanClaude.notificationSound.onTaskCompl.description: Play a sound when Claude Code finishes a task (command exits)

jeanClaude.rainbowCsv.enabled.markdownDescription:
Color each column of CSV and TSV files (`.csv`, `.tsv`, `.tab`) in its own color, so the columns are easy to follow. The delimiter (`,` `;` tab `|`) is detected automatically, and quoted fields (including ones spanning several lines) are respected.

You can also turn this on or off by clicking **Jean Claude** in the status bar.
